e04-sofia-reads-tv-off.observed_description: Evening in Sofia's living room: Sofia (long curly dark hair, warm brown skin, white blouse under a bright blue blazer, as in 1.2 q03) sits in a mustard-yellow armchair under a black floor lamp and reads an open dark-red hardcover held in her hands, eyes on the page, smiling slightly. To her right a large flat TV on a low white cabinet is plainly switched off: a solid black screen (about 45 percent of the photo width) with only a tiny red standby light. Window of deep blue evening sky behind. No remote, no text, nobody else. Hands natural.
e04-sofia-reads-tv-off.note: Usable: reading and TV-off read at every size down to 180 px. Deviation: Flash placed Sofia at the left, so the centered 4:5 crop cuts her face in half; the open book in her hands and the black TV stay inside, so the action stays unmistakable (guardrail: window-like 4:5 crops are acceptable when the action stays clear).

e03-luis-watches-tv.observed_description: Evening living room: Luis (short dark curly hair, clean-shaven, warm medium-brown skin, navy crew-neck T-shirt, as in 1.2 q01) sits on a dark-blue fabric sofa, seen from behind his left shoulder in near-profile, and watches a large flat TV on a low wooden cabinet; the screen is on and glows with soft abstract blue and orange light (no text, no faces). He holds a black TV remote in his right hand. A tripod floor lamp gives warm light; the windows show the deep blue evening sky. Nobody else; no text. Hands natural.
e03-luis-watches-tv.note: Usable: TV-on and watching read at every size down to 180 px. Deviations: near-profile rather than three-quarter face (as 1.7 h04 was accepted), and Flash placed Luis at the left, so the centered 4:5 crop keeps only a sliver of his head; the glowing TV and his hand with the remote stay inside, so watching TV stays unmistakable.

e01-ana-cooks-dinner.observed_description: Evening home kitchen: Ana (long dark wavy hair, light-olive skin, sage-green overshirt over a white top, jeans, as in 1.2 q02) stands at a gas stove and stirs a stainless-steel pot with a wooden spoon, her other hand on the pot handle. On the counter a wooden cutting board holds chopped tomatoes and a red onion. Wooden cabinets, white mugs on an open shelf, a small plant on the windowsill and a window of deep blue evening sky. No plate of food and no set table. Face in three-quarter profile, not looking at the camera; hands natural.
e01-ana-cooks-dinner.note: Usable: cooking dinner at home in the evening reads at every size down to 180 px and inside the centered 4:5 crop. Note: the stove's control panel shows small green display glyphs at the far left edge; they are unreadable even zoomed in and fall outside the 4:5 crop.

e02-diego-eats-at-a-restaurant.observed_description: Evening in a small restaurant: Diego (dark curly hair with a little grey, short full beard, burgundy button shirt, as in 1.2 q04) sits alone at a small table with a white tablecloth and eats dinner with a fork and knife from a plate of rice, chicken and green vegetables; a glass of water and a folded napkin are beside the plate. Other tables with white cloths and dark chairs stand empty, warm pendant lamps hang above and a wooden service counter is at the right; the big front window shows the blue evening street with lights. No stove, pot or cooking. Hands natural.
e02-diego-eats-at-a-restaurant.note: Usable: a restaurant (not a home) and eating dinner read at every size down to 180 px and inside the centered 4:5 crop. Deviation: a heavily blurred figure stands on the street outside the window at the left; it is barely visible at phone sizes and falls outside the 4:5 crop.
